The previous version of MPGEN consisted of a python-based web service api (code located at /mnt/AAD0BF13D0BEE4AB/Projects/Python/mpgen) and a reactjs based web ui (code located at /mnt/AAD0BF13D0BEE4AB/Projects/React/mpgenui)

The goal of this project is to simplyfiy the architecture by consolidating the web service API and the web UI into a more streamlined and maintainable structure with limited dependence on external frameworks and services.  The plan is to build a standalone html and javascript based page that handles both the frontend and backend logic.
